title: 2-Day Workshop at the Studio (Simsbury, CT)
evidence_sentence: The teaching page lists a 2-day workshop at the Simsbury, Connecticut studio on September 19-20, focused on raku and saggar firings offered there.
evidence_quote: For the past 30+ years,I have provided workshops focused is on Smoke, Obvara, Fuming, Saggar, and Raku.
summary: A two-day workshop at Vicente Garcia's Simsbury studio on September 19-20. The studio offers raku and saggar firing workshops.
how_to_join: Contact the studio to book or get on a list via the scheduling link on the teaching page.
cost_text: Workshop pricing starts at $325 per person per day for groups of 3-8 participants, or $1000 per day for 1-2 participants.
